## About

Utku Altınay is a full-stack developer based in İstanbul. His work centres on a single C# .NET API that serves several native clients: SwiftUI on iOS, Kotlin on Android, and React/Next.js on the web. He is studying Management Information Systems at İstanbul Medipol Üniversitesi and holds an associate degree in Computer Programming from İstanbul Arel Üniversitesi. He speaks Turkish (native), English (professional) and Japanese (elementary).

| Frontend | TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS |

## FAQ

### Who is Utku Altınay?
Utku Altınay is a full-stack developer in İstanbul, Türkiye, who builds multi-platform systems around a C# .NET API with SwiftUI, Kotlin and React/Next.js clients.

### Is Utku Altınay available for work?
Yes. He is open to full-time full-stack or .NET roles and selective freelance projects. Contact: https://utkualtinay.com/en#contact

### What has Utku Altınay built?
Revio (NFC customer-feedback SaaS), ArMenu (AR QR menus), FitApp (one .NET API with three native clients), TTRPG Companion (real-time Expo + SignalR app) and BT Support (Android request tracker).
